summary: Backend regression suite for Sahne Finance (Turkish iGaming financial dashboard). Wrote 18 pytest cases (sequential mode) covering seed data, transaction commission formula, bulk transactions, expenses/credits/transfers balance flows, dashboard KPIs, daily/monthly reports, CSV exports, payment method updates, and forced reseed. All 18/18 tests pass. Note: pytest.ini enforces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`; two tests race with the destructive `test_seed_force_wipes_and_reseeds` under parallel mode. Run with `-n 0` for stable results.

minor.issue: Default date range uses server local date (container is 2026-07). Frontend should always pass explicit date_from/date_to to guarantee KPI/daily_series alignment; balances are unfiltered which can confuse users comparing KPIs vs kasa balances.
Destructive endpoint has no auth; anyone can wipe all seeded lookup tables. Consider gating behind a token or removing from production build.
Silently ignores entries with unknown payment_method_id (returns saved count without warning). Acceptable but caller cannot detect partial saves.
Query param uses alias `date` (Python reserved-ish); works but doc/consumers must use ?date=YYYY-MM-DD, not date_str.

action_items: Consider protecting POST /api/seed?force=true (dangerous, no auth) - production risk
Frontend must pass explicit date_from/date_to to /api/dashboard to avoid server-clock month drift issues
server.py is 906 lines - split into routers (cash_registers, transactions, reports, exports, seed) for maintainability (>700 line threshold)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py 906 lines - exceeds 700 line guideline; should be split into routers/modules

compute_all_balances iterates transactions/transfers/expenses/credits one-by-one via `async for` on full collections - will not scale. Prefer $lookup aggregations or grouped queries for larger datasets.
No input validation on numeric fields for negative amounts (deposit/withdrawal/expense/transfer can be negative and silently corrupt balances). Add Pydantic constraints (Field(ge=0)).
Bulk endpoint deletes-then-inserts without a transaction — if insert fails mid-way, data for that date is lost. Consider mongo session/transactions or accumulate then swap.
POST /api/seed?force=true has no authentication; anyone with the URL can wipe metadata.
compute_all_balances treats credits.cash_register_id as optional; when None, kasa balance won't reflect credit, but dashboard KPI still counts it — leads to inconsistency between KPI and balances.
No unique index or dedupe on payment method names / kasa names; repeated seeding without force appends duplicates in edge cases (currently guarded by count check only).
GET /api/reports/daily uses alias `date` — collides with builtin; also causes ambiguity in OpenAPI docs. Consider `report_date`.
Deprecated FastAPI startup/shutdown decorators (@app.on_event) — should migrate to lifespan handlers.
seed_data_creation: Suite invokes POST /api/seed?force=true at session start via `seeded` fixture; individual tests clean up their own inserted transactions/expenses/credits/transfers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests via `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -n 0` (sequential). Parallel mode (-n 2, default from pytest.ini) causes 2 flaky failures because TestReseed wipes seed data mid-flight while other classes still reference stale IDs. Container date is 2026-07 — any dashboard test using default range should stick to July dates OR pass explicit date_from/date_to. Backend URL from /app/frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
rca of the issue: N/A - no backend bugs found. One initial test failure (test_credit_added_paid_updates_dashboard) was a test-side issue: I used January dates but /api/dashboard defaults to the server's current month (July 2026). Fixed by passing explicit date_from/date_to.
